method: Five jobs: none (1 SamplerV2 job), recipe (2 SamplerV2 jobs: native folding 1/3/5, and readout calibration; analyzed with recipe.py), IBM EstimatorV2 resilience_level 1, IBM EstimatorV2 resilience_level 2.
Compilation: level 2, best of 20 transpiler seeds (fewest two-qubit gates, then depth).

IBM SamplerV2 needs one shot count per job, so none and recipe get equal estimated quantum seconds as a method total (budget x circuits), not per circuit. IBM levels use the same shots per PUB as none (precision 1/sqrt(shots)) and add their own overhead. Measured quantum_seconds are read from each job.
RMSE vs exact noise-free values; spread = bootstrap std (Sampler: multinomial resampling of counts; Estimator: normal draws from the reported std).
